entries.proposition: All four capsids carried CMV-driven eGFP, not a therapeutic cargo.
entries.snippet: Each vector contained a genome expressing enhanced green fluorescent protein (eGFP) controlled by the cytomegalovirus (CMV) promoter

entries.proposition: Injection was intravenous (temporal vein) at postnatal day 2 and animals were analysed at P30.
entries.snippet: The mice were sacrificed on P30, after which analyses were performed.

entries.proposition: The authors convert the per-pup dose to about 5 x 10^12 vg/kg for a roughly 2 g pup.
entries.snippet: For a P2 pup (~2.0 g body weight), this corresponds to approximately

entries.proposition: DRG transduction by rAAV2-retro and PHP.eB was minimal, 4- to 6-fold lower than AAV9 and MacpnS1, by eGFP fluorescence intensity.
entries.snippet: approximately 4- to 6-fold lower than those of AAV9 and AAV-MacpnS1

entries.proposition: Liver stress markers were measured once, at 28 days; only MacpnS1 raised ALT and AST significantly.
entries.snippet: Only the AAV-MacpnS1 group registered significant increases in both

entries.proposition: The authors state that serum enzyme elevation does not establish hepatotoxicity.
entries.snippet: An increase in serum transaminase alone does not definitively establish hepatotoxicity

entries.proposition: Only one biochemical time point; no liver genome copies or histopathology.
entries.snippet: The biochemical analysis for this research was performed for a single time point only

entries.proposition: No immune endpoints (cytokines, anti-AAV antibodies, complement) were measured.
entries.snippet: without evaluation of broader immune responses, including cytokine profiles, anti-AAV antibody production, or complement activation

entries.proposition: The neonatal blood-brain barrier at P2 is stated to be more permissive; findings are not to be extrapolated to adult CNS.
entries.snippet: our findings should not be directly extrapolated to adult CNS applications

entries.proposition: PHP.eB depends on Ly6a and is strain-specific; Ly6a and Ly6c1 are absent in primates.
entries.snippet: Ly6a and Ly6c1 are absent in primates

entries.proposition: The Discussion calls the MacpnS1 enzyme rise acute liver injury, stronger than the Results wording.
entries.snippet: ALT, AST, and ALP-2c levels increased significantly, indicating acute liver injury
